rule_outs: Dwelling 6 m from the best section
summary: Arterial kerb with no parking, apartments and houses within 10 m along most of it.
reasons: Verge too narrow to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 12 m away at the start, houses 6 m at 14 m, flats 2-3 m beyond; overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs along driveways and hedges; no clear bay beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-lane arterial with centre line and turning at junctions.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this kerb in either image; signs mix 2P and No Stopping.

sun_shade: Mostly open to the sky, with hedge shade from the south.

best_section.where: Sir Fred Schonell Drive south kerb, west end beside the corner house
